newsitem.title: USA: First Industrial Realty completes offering.
newsitem.headline: First Industrial Realty completes offering.

text.p: First Industrial Realty Trust Inc said Tuesday it completed its offering of two million depositary shares.
The shares were priced to yield 8.625 percent.
The company also granted an option to purchase up to an additional 300,000 shares solely to cover overallotments.

The net proceeds of the offering, which totaled approximately $48.4 million excluding the overallotment, will be used to repay the balance outstanding under the company's acquisition facility, to fund future acquisition and development activity, and other general corporate purposes.
Depositary shares will be redeemable at the option of the company at any time after 10 years at $25 a share, plus accrued and unpaid dividends.
The annual dividend is $2.15625 a share.
The series C cumulative preferred stock is not convertible into common shares, the company said.
Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette Securities Corp, Smith Barney Inc and Prudential Securities Inc represented the underwriters for the offering.
First Industrial is a real estate investment trust.
